THE DISTINCTIVE PERSPECTIVE

From investigation
to advocacy.

A case is shaped long before it reaches a courtroom.

Thirty-five years in police service, culminating at the rank of Additional Superintendent of Police, inform Rakesh Kumar Puri’s approach to records, witnesses, forensic material and the sequence of a criminal investigation.

His legal practice focuses primarily on criminal law and constitutional writ matters, with attention to how evidence is gathered, tested and presented.
